Name: Speed Mod
Author: beornblackclaw
Description:
[size=5][center]﻿Overview[/center][/size]This mod adds a speed boost and the ability to teleport home at the cost of stamina. This could be considered cheating but I consider it more of QoL mod because of the built-in limitations.

[center][youtube]PtgfM0SvUS8[/youtube]
[youtube]d1NO8vTFT5s[/youtube][/center]
[center][size=5]Changelog[/size][/center][size=4][b][u]Version 1.2[/u] [/b][/size]
[list]
[*] ﻿Added an alternative method to detect configuration modifications if the ModTabSettings integration fails
[*] Added support for interrupting the teleportation process (manually or through damage)
[*] The energy used by the teleportation is drained over time during the casting period
[*] The speed boost is disabled if the player is under the tipsy or slimed debuffs (both impact movement speed)
[*] Added a teleport effect matching the one from the totems
[/list]
[u][size=4]Version 1.01-beta[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]ModTabSettings integration
[/list]
[u][size=4]Version 1.0[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Initial release
[/list][center][size=5]Configuration
[/size][/center]Most aspects of the mod are configurable through the [code]config.json[/code] file.

[size=4][code]SpeedModifier:[/code][/size]
Value of the speed boost.
[i]integer[/i] [0-25] (default: [b]2[/b])

[code][size=4]TeleportHomeKey[/size][size=4][code]:[/code][/size][/code]
The key used to trigger the teleportation (displays a confirmation dialog).
[i]keybind[/i] [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]wiki reference[/url] (default: [b]H[/b])


[code][size=4][code]CanPlayerInterrupt: [/code][/size][/code]?NEW 1.2
Allows the player to cancel the teleportation if the activation key is pressed again.
⚠ Any spent energy is not recovered.
[i]boolean[/i] [b]true [/b]/ [b]false [/b](default: [b]true[/b])


[code][size=4]CanDamageInterrupt[/size][/code][size=4][code]:[/code][/size] ?NEW 1.2
Allows damage to interrupt the teleportation if the threshold is reached (See [DamageThreshold]([project]damagethreshold-new-12[/project])).
⚠ Any spent energy is not recovered.
[i]boolean[/i] [b]true [/b]/ [b]false [/b](default: [b]true[/b])


[code][size=4][code]DamageThresholdBasedOnTotalHealth: [/code][/size][/code]?NEW 1.2
Controls how the damage threshold is evaluated (See [DamageThreshold]([project]damagethreshold-new-12[/project])):
[list]
[*]if [b]true[/b], based on the [cur]total health[/cur] (chance of interruption is linear: easier)
[*]if [b]false[/b], based on the [cur]remaining health[/cur] (chance of interruption increases as health declines: harder).
[/list][i]boolean[/i] [b]true [/b]/ [b]false [/b](default: [b]true[/b])


[size=4][code]DamageThreshold: [/code][/size]?NEW 1.2
The amount of damage in % of the player's health that would interrupt the teleportation.
[i]integer[/i] [0-90] (default: [b]10[/b])


[code][size=4][code]StaminaCost: [/code][/size][/code]
The amount of stamina depleted when teleporting home.
[i]integer[/i] (default: [b]50[/b])


[code][size=4][code]RecastCooldown: [/code][/size][/code]
The time period for which the teleportation is on cooldown (also resets at the end of the day).
[i]timespan[/i] [b]HH:MM:SS[/b] (default: [b]00:07:00[/b])


[code][size=4]CastCooldown[/size][/code][size=4][code]: [/code][/size]⚠ Modified 1.2
The time in seconds it takes to perform the teleportation.
‼ You need to edit your config.json manually or delete it or the new version won't be able to load the configuration.
[i]integer [/i](default: [b]5[/b]) ⚠ The type of the value was changed from [i]timespan[/i] to [i]integer[/i].


[size=4][code]TeleportToBed: [/code][/size]?NEW 1.2
Controls whether the player is teleported to their bed or outside the farm (same as the Return Scepter).
[i]boolean[/i] [b]true[/b] / [b]false[/b] (default: [b]true[/b])


[code][size=4][code]EnableTeleportationEffects: [/code][/size][/code]?NEW 1.2
Enables or disables the visual effects.
[i]boolean[/i] [b]true[/b] / [b]false[/b] (default: [b]true[/b])


[code][/code][size=4][code]EnableTeleportationSounds: [/code][/size]?NEW 1.2
Enables or disables the sound effects.
[i]boolean[/i] [b]true[/b] / [b]false[/b] (default: [b]true[/b])


[code][size=4][code]EnableInMultiplayer:
[/code][/size][/code]Flag specifying if the teleportation feature is enabled in multiplayer.
[i]boolean[/i] [b]true[/b] / [b]false[/b] (default: [b]false[/b])

[size=5][center]Example file:[/center][/size][code]{
  "SpeedModifier": 2,
  "TeleportHomeKey": "H",
  "CanPlayerInterrupt": true,
  "CanDamageInterrupt": true,
  "DamageThreshold": 15,
  "DamageThresholdBasedOnTotalHealth": true,
  "StaminaCost": 50,
  "RecastCooldown": "00:07:00",
  "CastCooldown": 3,
  "TeleportToBed": false,
  "EnableTeleportationEffects": true,
  "EnableTeleportationSounds": true,
  "EnabledInMultiplayer": true
}
[/code]
[url=https://github.com/Xebeth/StardewValley-SpeedMod]Source code[/url] available on [url=https://github.com]Github[/url].
